data.name: Huthayfa
data.gender_notes: Huthayfa is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Huthayfa ibn al-Yaman was an Ansar companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). He was known for his bravery and loyalty. The name Huthayfa carries the meaning “Friend of the Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Huthayfa usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of the prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies companionship and devotion to the Prophet.
data.etymology: Huthayfa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of the Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Huthayfa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: حُذَيْفَة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من حذف، بمعنى المقتطف أو المختص
in_arabic.long_meaning: حُذَيْفَة هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'حَذَفَ' التي تعني 'مَنَعَ' أو 'أَذْهَبَ بِهِ'. ورد اسم حُذَيْفَة في السيرة النبوية، حيث كان حُذَيْفَة بن بدر الصَّحابيَّ الجليل أحد كبار الصحابة ورواة الحديث النبوي. هذا الاسم يحمل دلالات قوة وسرعة في الاستجابة والانتباه، كما يعبر عن الشخص الذي يتصف بالحذف أي السرعة في الحركة أو اتخاذ القرارات.

in_urdu.name: حذیفہ
in_urdu.meaning: حذیفہ نام کا مطلب ہے - چھوٹا سا حصہ لینے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: حذیفہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'مقتطف' یا 'مختص'. یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں معروف ہے کیونکہ حذیفہ بن بدر ایک صحابی رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم تھے۔ یہ نام ان کی شخصیت کی مضبوطی اور سیرت کی تعبیر کرتا ہے۔ اس نام کا استعمال مسلم معاشرے میں روایتی اور تاریخی اہمیت کا حامل ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا میں جہاں اردو زبان بولی جاتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हुज़ैफा
in_hindi.meaning: हुज़ैफा का अर्थ है - एक छोटा सा हिस्सा लेने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: हुज़ैफा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है 'मुक्षतस' या 'विशेष'. इस नाम का संबंध इस्लामी इतिहास से है क्योंकि हुज़ैफा बिन बदर एक प्रमुख सहाबा और पैगंबर मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम के अनुयायी थे। यह नाम उनके व्यक्तित्व की दृढ़ता और सच्चाई को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का उपयोग पारंपरिक और ऐतिहासिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: حُذَيْفَه
in_pashto.meaning: د حُذَيْفَه نوم معنی دے - لنډه برخه اخستونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: حُذَيْفَه د عربي نوم دی چې معنی يې 'مقتطف' یا 'مختص' دی. دا نوم په اسلامي تاريخ کې د اهميت وړ دی ځکه چې حُذَيْفَه بن بدر د پيغمبر محمد صلی الله عليه وسلم يو له اصحابو څخه و. دا نوم د هغه د قوي شخصيت او د رسول الله صلی الله عليه وسلم د پيروۍ دلالت کوي. په افغانستان او پښتونخوا کې د مسلمانانو په ميانو کې دا نوم دود دی.

in_english.name: Huthayfa
in_english.meaning: One who takes a small part or selected portion
in_english.long_meaning: Huthayfa is a masculine Arabic name derived from the root 'ḥ-dh-f', meaning 'to take a small part' or 'to select'. The name Huthayfa holds historical significance as it was the name of Huthayfa bin Badr, a notable companion of Prophet Muhammad. The name symbolizes strength, agility, and attentiveness. It reflects a person who is swift in action or decision-making. The name carries spiritual connotations of being chosen or selected for a purpose, resonating with Islamic values of dedication and service.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Huthayfa" is a reminder of the profound contributions of early Muslims, specifically the Ansar, in the spread of Islam. Ansar were local residents of Medina who warmly welcomed and supported the new Muslim community led by Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name Huthayfa showcases the spirit of unity, hospitality, and camaraderie that was integral to the early Muslim community.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Huthayfa" symbolizes the virtues of loyalty, bravery, and sacrifice that Muslims are encouraged to embody in their faith. Huthayfa ibn al-Yaman is an exemplar of these qualities and serves as an inspiration to follow the footsteps of the Prophet and his companions. The name carries a spiritual meaning reminding us to live a life of faithfulness to Allah and stand firm in our beliefs despite adversities.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Friend of the Prophet" symbolizes Huthayfa ibn al-Yaman was an Ansar companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). He was known for his bravery and loyalty.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Huthayfa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of friend of the prophet.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Huthayfa ibn Al-Yaman was a prominent Sahabi (companion of the Prophet Muhammad) who embraced Islam before the hijrah (migration to Medina) in 622 CE. He was known for his bravery and strong faith, and participated in several battles with the Prophet, including the Battle of Uhud.
historical_references.context: Sahabi, Companion of the Prophet Muhammad, Bravery, Battle of Uhud

historical_references.reference: Huthayfa ibn Al-Yaman was also a key figure during the early Rashidun Caliphate. He served as the governor of Kufa under Caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab and later under Caliph Uthman ibn Affan. He was known for his fairness and justice, and played a significant role in the administration of the early Islamic state.
historical_references.context: Key figure during the early Rashidun Caliphate, Governor of Kufa, Fairness and Justice, Administration of the early Islamic state

modern_usage.modern_context: Huthayfa ibn al-Yaman is a significant figure in Islamic and Middle Eastern history, best known for his military leadership in the early Muslim army. His name is often mentioned in discussions related to the Ridda Wars, the first major military campaign led by Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) against the Arab tribes who refused to accept Islam. Huthayfa's bravery and strategic acumen were crucial in several key battles, including the Battle of Uhud and the Battle of Hunain. Today, his name is frequently mentioned in academic and scholarly contexts, as well as in online conversations among Muslims and history enthusiasts on platforms like Twitter, Reddit, and Academia.edu.
